```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(reach.postproc)
render_mermaid <- function(diagram) {
  if (requireNamespace("DiagrammeR", quietly = TRUE)) return(DiagrammeR::mermaid(diagram))
  knitr::asis_output(paste0("```mermaid\n", diagram, "\n```"))
}
```

p<-default_ar_parameters();assess(p)@summary;root_table(roots(p))
